Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Keep CanvasWorkspace and MappingDocumentController as state owners; identify MappingEditorCanvas as the editor adapter and workspace tools and SourceWindowPanel as page-owned UI. This preserves the overview's ownership structure and supplies attachment nodes for the new details.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Keep source-code and code-panel projections in display state, but distinguish their ownership from SourceWindowPanel's rendering of an expanded visible pane.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace DiagramService content writes with issued and retained revisions; retain atomic controller batches and separately committed agent mutations.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Preserve checkpoint bindings and navigation, but remove the claim that history itself issues changed diagram revisions.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- The service-centered lifecycle is obsolete. Organize content creation around revision operations, explicit retention, generation orchestration and separate canvas publication; preserve immutable revision identities.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Source window and source navigation
  |       `-- Develop [C] ProjectedPane: SourceWindowPanel hosts a visible expanded source projection; SourceCodePane owns file loading, stale-source handling, definitions and scroll navigation.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Make uploaded context optional; show saved diagram context, pinned references and templates before generation, then distinguish revision installation from new-diagram placement. Retain acknowledgement retries without model reruns.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   `-- Add edit and replacement modes, subtree scopes, templates, references and panel session identity; distinguish create-diagram and extend-diagram inputs.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   `-- Add variant and created-diagram results; publish updated agent context only after canvas acknowledgement.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |       `-- Show optional context seeding and rendered template and reference input while preserving isolation from the original trajectory.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Add create and extend generation, bounded revision reads, CanvasView and projection commands, checkpoint publication, Agent Chat and diff-session interfaces to their existing groups.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       `-- Reorganize the expanded backend around live bridge reads and commands, generation acknowledgement, proposal workflows and durable publication; retain direct exec mutations.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Preserve catalog, workspace and immutable-record boundaries; distinguish workspace checkpoint flushing from catalog publication and identify repository and context persistence callers. Do not describe proposed SearchArtifact hooks as implemented.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [D] Baseline/proposed -> unified review
  |       `-- Add the diff tree's read-only change treemap projection while retaining the distinction between review-only matches and authoritative diagram anchors.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Add CanvasView checkpoint and working-copy callers and projected-child writes; distinguish retained source-pane state from window-panel layout state.
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   `-- [2] Add: CanvasView command and checkpoint ownership
  |       `-- Develop Saved view and Switch views: CanvasViewReceiver routes lifecycle commands to controller checkpoints and workspace persistence; diff preview reads a saved view without switching the active one.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) - Projection  existing canvas
  |   `-- [2] Add: Alternative controls and SidePanel rendering
  |       `-- Develop [P1] Presentation alternatives: placement controls swap choices or open pinned parts; SidePanel renders regular or diff content in flow or overlay without rebinding content.
  |-- [3] Editor canvas runtime  new canvas
  |   `-- MappingEditorCanvas and CanvasRuntime ownership
  |       `-- Connect from MappingPage's MappingEditorCanvas component; distinguish editor-owned interaction and shape projection from controller-owned documents, presentation, selection and edits.
  |-- [3] Prompt composition and diagram generation  new canvas
  |   |-- PromptComposer and PromptComposerCoordinator
  |   |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's workspace tools; cover draft lifetime, selection-bound and manual pinned references, templates, polling and exact-request retries.
  |   `-- Generation, variants and acknowledgement
  |       `-- Connect to [D1] EditDiagramInput; distinguish edit installation, new-diagram placement, review decisions and optional presentation promotion.
  |-- [3] Canvas and change treemaps  new canvas
  |   |-- Treemap inputs and allocation
  |   |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's Treemaps tool and ChangeSession review; canvas mode validates captured mappings against source files, while change mode allocates captured text-hunk LOC to resolved diff-tree destinations.
  |   `-- Read-only display and navigation
  |       `-- Cover file and diagram hierarchies, shared and unmapped area, unresolved inputs, navigation and tint selection without treating treemap regions as content edits.
  `-- [3] Focused canvas projection  new canvas
      |-- Projection creation and ownership
      |   `-- Connect from MappingPage's projectDiagrams component; a worker copies selected placements into an independent child canvas with source provenance and a blank placeholder.
      `-- Projection layout and navigation
          `-- Cover geometry-only worker calculation, controller layout checkpoints and child-only projection undo and redo; the source canvas remains in place.
